actions: Resolved SHA-only control tuple and repeated pre-semantic head check until stable.
Read only minimum own clean continuation state.
Researched public primary/near-primary sources for interface-recovery interaction, failure-scope routing, early-warning lead time, and reviewer guidance.
Persisted a new role-local checkpoint and advanced the role-local latest pointer using CAS/readback-safe writes.
new_findings: DARC provides a strong partial 2x2 interaction: recovery guidance is approximately ineffective on the full action surface but highly effective when paired with a guard-ranked admissible action view; difference-in-differences is about +46.27 percentage points in the tested ALFWorld condition.
Matched-information controls show random restriction or metadata alone do not explain DARC's gain; diagnosis-intervention compatibility is load-bearing.
H-RePlan supports failure-scope-dependent local repair versus global reassignment/replanning.
PrefixGuard shows eventual failure detection metrics can overstate control value when early actionable warning recall is low.
scope_guards: DARC is not an external-state/authority/effect-semantics interface test and does not close the stronger software/API 2x2 frontier.
H-RePlan uses an author-constructed cross-device benchmark.
Reviewer evidence without exact same-prefix randomization remains subject to branch-selection/stochastic confounding.
A withdrawn coding-router manuscript was treated as provisional and not promoted to headline evidence.
termination: scheduled invocation checkpoint; open-ended frontier remains nonempty
exact_next_action: Search for a software/API external-state 2x2 crossing operable/authoritative interface semantics with identical fixed recovery, including a true no-interface/no-recovery cell and full hidden-retry accounting; in parallel search exact same-prefix randomized reviewer/advice ON/OFF and reviewer/advice x verification factorials.
